proposals.answer: Yes. The fix may name the test file that the feature builds. It never says which test caught the problem.
proposals.context: The rule says a fix the builder gets names what the builder sees and changes in the product (expectation-generation.md, lines 88-92). When a feature builds a test file, that file is part of what the builder changes. The fix still never says which test caught the problem, so the builder does not learn where its own tests are.
